To,

All Zonal ACC-HQs/ACCs (Zone)
All RPFC-I’s in charge of Regional Offices

Subject: Instructions for Monthly review of the Regional Offcies on Exemption matters
Madam/Sir,

As per Para 6(c) of Chapter 1 of the new simplified SOP on EPF Exemption, approved by the
239th CBT, the Zonal Office is required to take a monthly review of the Regional Offices.

The following issues may be deliberated by the Zonal Heads

Status of ZO wise pendency of Surrender and Cancellation cases and list of such cases pending with HO.
Status of cancellation orders pending with State Governments and HO/Central Government.

Status of grant of exemption cases- cases where relaxation orders have been issued and those pending at
Head Office

ZO wise Compliance Audit status for the year 2023-2024 and 2024-2025

Grievances. Credit of past accumulations in cases of surrender and cancellation of exemption. Cases
where members have suffered loss of interest on account of transfer of past accumulation to EPFO

Cases of frauds and action taken in this regard

Defaults on contribution and interest payments.

Issue tracker cases. IT reforms.

Online surrender module- whether functional and difficulties being faced in this regard by the field
offices.

Cases of assessment,recovery of dues, damages, interest and surcharge

Conducting outreach programmes and ensure sharing of best practices followed by Trusts with all
establishments under their jurisdiction.

Timely submission of online returns.

Such other issues which the Zonal Head may find important for monthly review as part of the monitoring
mechanism

2. Accordingly all the Zonal Heads are therefore requested to submit the minutes of the month ly review
with respect to progress on the above aspects beginning from April, 2026.

The minutes may be submitted by 10" of the following month.
(This issues with the approval of CPFC )
